sources.title: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-405B-FP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Optimizations This model was obtained by quantizing the weights and activations of Meta-Llama-3.1-405B to FP8 data type, ready for inference with vLLM built from source. This optimization reduces the number of bits per parameter from 16 to 8, reducing the disk size and GPU memory requirements by approximately 50%.

sources.snippet: Overview Meta-Llama-3.1-405B-FP8 is a 405-billion parameter multilingual instruction-tuned large language model built by meta-llama. This is the largest model in the Llama 3.1 family, quantized to FP8 precision for reduced memory requirements while maintaining full capability.
